subject: Renewal + Reserved Pool increase — credit request & decision path
messages:
From: Ben Li <ben.li@starnet.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@starnet.com>, contracts@starnet.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal notice — proposal to expand reserved pool + request on credits

Hi Neha,

We're coming up on our renewal (Aug 15) and our usage keeps trending higher than we forecasted. We ran a capacity forecast and want to move from a 4-GPU reserved pool to a 12-GPU pool to handle steady-state throughput spikes and a new model variant we'll be launching in Q4.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood give a one-time renewal credit to offset the additional committed spend tied to the pool increase?
- We'd like a 6-month price lock and a throughput guarantee tied to p50 latency for 8K tokens.

I've attached June usage and a draft SOW for the new pool. Alice is copied for procurement. Looking to lock terms before our finance review next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Li
Head of ML Engineering, Starnet Analytics
attachments: Starnet_Monthly_Usage_June2026.csv, Proposed_SOW_Starnet_2026-08.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Li <ben.li@starnet.com>
Cc: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@starnet.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice — proposal to expand reserved pool + request on credits

Hi Ben — thanks for the heads up and for the SOW + usage file.

We can absolutely support expanding to a 12-GPU reserved pool and a 6-month price lock. For credits, I need to surface this to our renewal/finance team since the uplift is material and tied to committed capacity. Quick answers for your meeting prep:
- We can offer a one-time onboarding/commitment credit; exact amount pending internal approval.
- Throughput SLA: we can commit to a p50 latency target for the 8K token profile once the pool is provisioned and the model variant is verified; would like a short tech validation window after handover.

I'll loop in finance and the renewal lead and aim to get a decision within 48 hours. Is there flexibility on the effective date if provisioning slips?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0196

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal notice — Starnet asks for 12-GPU pool + one-time credit — need approval path

Team — forwarding customer's ask. Highlights: 4->12 GPUs, 6-month price lock, p50 latency guarantee for 8K tokens. They asked for a one-time credit to offset the increased committed spend; finance will need a recommended concession amount and any conditions (SOW acceptance, DOCSIGN).

Numbers: Starnet current committed monthly spend: ~$95k. Proposed committed monthly spend with 12-GPU pool (w/ standard discounts): ~$265k. They are a mid-market strategic customer, good retention, rolling out a high-visibility feature.

Suggested options to vote on: 1) Approve up to 10% one-time credit on the incremental committed ARR, contingent on a 12-month renewal; 2) Approve a 6% credit + engineering validation clause and limited SLA exposure; 3) Decline credit, offer professional services discount instead.

I recommend option 2 given risk profile. Need sign-off from Sales Lead and Finance.

Thanks — Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal notice — Starnet asks for 12-GPU pool + one-time credit — need approval path

+1 to Neha's recommendation (option 2). Rationale: keeps our upside, reduces SLA legal exposure, and ties credit to engineering validation and a signed amendment. Approve up to 6% of incremental committed ARR as a one-time credit, with the following conditions:
- Must sign amendment (DocuSign link) within 14 days.
- Engineering validation window of 10 business days post-provisioning; SLA kicks in after validation.
- Credit applied as a one-time invoice credit at contract effective date.

Karthik — please confirm finance is okay with 6% and the timing of the credit application (invoice vs. rebate).

Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal notice — Starnet asks for 12-GPU pool + one-time credit — need approval path

Agreed on process. Finance approves up to 6% one-time credit on incremental committed ARR to be processed as an invoice credit on the first billing cycle of the new term, contingent on receiving the signed amendment within 14 calendar days. We will require the amendment to clearly list the upgraded reserved pool, commit period, and credit amount. Also need a single PO or confirmed billing contact from Starnet.

Jonas, please prepare the amendment (Redwood_Amendment_Draft.docx) and the DocuSign packet. Neha — confirm whether the customer can share a PO number by Friday EOD so we can meet the billing timeline.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Operations

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Li <ben.li@starnet.com>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@starnet.com>, contracts@starnet.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: one-time credit & next steps for reserved pool increase

Ben / Alice — good news. Internal approvals are in place for the reserved pool increase and a one-time credit per the conditions below. Summary of decision:

- Approved: one-time credit equal to 6% of the incremental committed ARR (applied as invoice credit on the first billing cycle of the renewed term).
- Conditions: signed amendment via DocuSign within 14 days; engineering validation window of 10 business days after provisioning; SLA for p50 latency on the agreed 8K token profile begins after validation completes.
- Billing / PO: please provide a PO or billing-confirmation email to contracts@starnet.com by Fri 10 Jul to keep provisioning on track.
- DocuSign + amendment: Jonas will send the docusign packet (Redwood_Amendment_Draft.docx).

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Starnet to sign amendment & provide PO — owner: Starnet (Alice) — ETA: 2026-07-10
- Redwood to send DocuSign and finalize amendment — owner: Jonas — ETA: 2026-07-03 (sent)
- Provision reserved 12-GPU pool once amendment signed and PO received — owner: Infra Ops — ETA: target week of 2026-07-20
- Engineering validation and SLA handover — owner: Redwood Eng — ETA: 10 business days after provisioning

I'll send the DocuSign link and the formal amendment copy in a separate email. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0196
attachments: Redwood_Amendment_Draft.docx
